name: sitting yoga pose siddhasana
description: A calm cross-legged seat that opens the hips and teaches you to sit tall.
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend your knees.
Place one heel against your inner thigh and the other foot in front of it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Switch the cross of your legs and repeat.
